# Sirach Chapter 16 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 16 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_016_page_001.jpg

---

**16:1** Do not long for a multitude of useless children, or take pleasure in ungodly sons.

**16:2** If they are many, do not rejoice in them unless the fear of the LORD is in them.

**16:3** Do not trust in their survival, and do not rely on their numbers; for one is better than a thousand, and to die without children is better than to have ungodly ones.

**16:4** For through one person of understanding a city may be repopulated, but a clan of the lawless will be made desolate.

**16:5** Many such things my eyes have seen, and my ears have heard things greater than these.

**16:6** In the assembly of sinners a fire is kindled, and in a rebellious nation wrath is ignited.

**16:7** He had no mercy for the ancient giants who rebelled in their strength.

**16:8** He did not spare the neighbors of Lot, whom he abhorred for their arrogance.

**16:9** He showed no mercy to the nation devoted to destruction, those expelled because of their sins.

**16:10** And likewise with the six hundred thousand foot soldiers who were gathered in the stubbornness of their hearts — even if there had been only one stiff-necked person among them, it would have been remarkable if he escaped unpunished.

**16:11** For both mercy and wrath are with him; he is powerful in forgiveness and he pours out wrath.

**16:12** As great as his mercy, so also is his correction; he judges each person according to their works.

**16:13** A sinner will not escape with plunder, and the patience of the devout will not be cut short.

**16:14** He makes room for every act of mercy; each person will be repaid according to their deeds.

**16:15** He hardened Pharaoh so that he would not acknowledge him, so that the works of the LORD might be made known throughout the world.

**16:16** His mercy is manifest to all creation, and his light and darkness he has apportioned to the human race.

**16:17** Do not say, "I will be hidden from the LORD," or "Who up above will remember me? Among so many people I will not be noticed; for what is my soul amid so vast a creation?"

**16:18** Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens, the deep and the earth, will quake at his visitation;

**16:19** together with the mountains and the foundations of the earth — when God looks upon them, they tremble and quake.

**16:20** But no heart takes thought of these things; and who gives thought to his ways?

**16:21** Like a storm that no eye can see, so most of his works remain hidden.

**16:22** Who will proclaim his deeds of justice? Or who will wait for them? For the appointed time is far off.

**16:23** The person of little understanding turns these things over in his mind, and the foolish, misguided person entertains foolish notions.

**16:24** Listen to me, my child, and acquire knowledge; give your heart to my words.

**16:25** I will set forth my instruction with precision, and declare knowledge carefully.

**16:26** When the LORD created his works from the beginning, as he was making them he assigned their portions.

**16:27** He arranged his works in an eternal order, and their dominions from generation to generation. They do not hunger or grow weary, and they never cease from their work.

**16:28** None encroaches upon another, and they will never disobey his word.

**16:29** After all this, the LORD looked upon the earth and filled it with his good things.

**16:30** With all kinds of living creatures he covered its surface, and to it they shall return.
